text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Gentildonna hasn't been in top shape
lately, so we headed to the shrine for a change of pace."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"My, what magnificent dragon ornamentation.
Amidst its rugged style, one can truly feel wabi-sabi."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I wonder if there are any other sculptures?
choice_data_list: Isn't that statue over there a sumo wrestler?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho~ ho~ ho~.
Impressive of you to see through my 'Wait, isn't that the Golshi I helped the other day?' Jutsu! Nin-nin!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, ya know... apparently it's happening today!
The legendary event—SHIRI-ZUMOU, that is!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, a signboard in the shrine grounds read:
"Annual Sacred Ritual: Hip-Pushing Tournament."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
As an Event Hunter, the great Golshi-sama
can't just overlook this!
You're joining in too, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how rude.
Deciding my schedule without asking.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Meeting here is fate—5-6-4 fate!!
If we share the same 5-6-4, might as well sing a chanson!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Or does the 'Gentildonna' not fancy hip-hop?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho, what a cheap provocation.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I do have an interest in sumo.
After all, it is a truly pure clash of strength.”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: This hip-pushing game... It is a sacred ritual, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "I have no intention of praying to God, but I thought I'd engage in some superstitious rituals to shake off this slump."

text_block_list.name: Sumo Referee
text_block_list.text:
Now then, take your stances~~...
Ready~~...

text_block_list.name: Gentil & Golshi
text_block_list.text: ――...STILL IN ITTTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHAAAM!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two Umamusume clash fiercely!!
A shockwave ripples across the shrine grounds, and then—...!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...This is a noble lady's hip-hop.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. To think I'd get pushed out like that.
Guess I was still just a little fry...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll turn into a full-grown yellowtail in no time!
Wash your neck and wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps thanks to her victory in this sacred ritual, Gentildonna had completely regained her form.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
First, allow me to say that was impressive.
To think that I was the one pushed out...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: “Still, that was some nice☆hip-hop! You gotta battle me again sometime.”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: When you're at your best, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, Gentildonna's slump continued even after this.
